versions.short: The bill would extend from 72 hours to 15 days the time allowed to notify the Indian Health Service's Purchased/Referred Care program about emergency medical care received from a non-IHS provider or at a non-IHS facility. The change would not apply to elderly or disabled individuals, who would keep the 30-day notification requirement for emergency services. The Indian Health Service provides medical and dental care directly to American Indian and Alaska Native patients when possible, and the Purchased/Referred Care program pays for care received away from its facilities.
